DECIDE: A or B.

A (dark) is what was open at handoff — cyan on deep blue-purple, hue 190/278.
B (warm amber) keeps the palette the brief specified — burnt amber on warm paper.

Same copy, same structure, same commands. This is purely the colour direction.

Once you pick, the other one gets deleted rather than kept around.

PLAYBACK — resolved, with two things to fix.

How it works: lines reveal on scroll into view, hidden by JS not CSS, so with JS off the whole transcript is simply visible. Honours prefers-reduced-motion, and fails open twice (a reveal-all timer and a 4s guard).

Fix 1: the label says 00:41 but playback defaults to 20s.
Fix 2: the pacing is invented weights, not the cast's real frame timings. The content is real; the rhythm is not — and the label claims a recording.

ADDED beyond the brief — all verified real, none invented:

• 'Three things that go wrong quietly'
• 'Two agents that have never met miss each other by six minutes' (the rendezvous gap)
• 'A hub can coordinate agents whose traffic it cannot read' (encryption)

New commands checked against the CLI: rendezvous --want, init --key -w, listen --until +<slot>. All exist.

But principle 5 says the smallness is the pitch. Nine sections is not small. Worth cutting one or two.
